evidence: Quint. 1.4.24: quae fēminīna positiōne marēs significant (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Said of nouns: nōmen fēminīnum; fēminīnī generis, of the feminine gender (Traupman 238). Of women and female animals, fēmina and muliebris serve.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 221, p. 238, p. 246.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 314.
